---
title: "Gallery"
---

These analyses use the small datasets from phit's documentation. Each
example ran when the documentation was built, and the output shown is the
output it produced. The CSV files are in [`docs/data`](https://github.com/phpstats/phplyr/tree/main/docs/data).

## School value added

The schools data has 250 students in 12 schools, with study hours, a prior
score, and a final score. A regression on all students gives each student an
expected score. Averaging the residuals by school ranks schools by how far
their students exceed that expectation.

{{< include examples/_gallery-schools.md >}}

## Schools as random intercepts

The same data as a mixed model: `lmer()` fits a random intercept for each
school. The intraclass correlation is the share of residual variance between
schools, and the estimated intercept shifts are shrunk toward zero compared
with the raw school means.

{{< include examples/_gallery-mixed.md >}}

## Rent per square meter

The housing data has eight flats. The first table summarizes area, rent, and
rent per square meter by number of bedrooms with `across()`. The second
compares each flat with its bedroom group using `by`.

{{< include examples/_gallery-housing.md >}}

## Pass rates by study time

The learning data records study hours, a practice score, and whether 80
students passed. `ntile()` splits students into study-hour quartiles, and a
logistic regression estimates the effect of an extra hour.

{{< include examples/_gallery-learning.md >}}

## Clinic calls by staffing

The clinic data has visitors, staff, and calls for 120 days. The example bands
staffing and visitor volume, averages calls, and widens the result into a
cross-tabulation.

{{< include examples/_gallery-clinic.md >}}
